# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/artifacts/{artifact_id}/zip

Downloads a specific artifact, redirecting to blob URL or serving directly

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-298`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| artifact_id | path | string | True |

## Response

**302** — redirect

- **400** — Invalid request
- **404** — Artifact not found, expired, or is v3 format

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | getArtifactByPathParam | utility | Parse artifact_id, fetch by ID, validate repo and status |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | DownloadArtifact (expiry check) | controller | Check if status is Expired -> 404; Check IsArtifactV4; Try DownloadArtifactV4ServeDirect (minio/azure direct URL); If not direct: build signed URL with HMAC-SHA256 and redirect 302 |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | actions_service.DownloadArtifactV4ServeDirect | service ⚡ | Check setting.Actions.ArtifactStorage.ServeDirect(); If minio/azure with ServeDirect: get presigned URL and redirect 302; Otherwise return false |
| 4 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | buildSigURL | utility | Create HMAC-SHA256 signature using app SecretKey; Build URL with sig and expires (60 min) query params |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Artifact must belong to the requesting repository and have valid status (confirmed or expired) | validation | !ok || art.RepoID != repo.ID || (art.Status != UploadConfirmed && art.Status != Expired) |
| Only v4 artifacts (content_encoding contains '/') are supported for single-artifact operations | validation | strings.Contains(art.ContentEncodingOrType, "/") |
| Download endpoint returns 404 for expired artifacts even if they exist in DB | business_logic | art.Status == ArtifactStatusExpired |
| Download uses signed URL with HMAC-SHA256 and 60-minute expiry for redirect-based downloads | business_logic | ServeDirect is false (no minio/azure direct URL) |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Artifact not found or wrong repo | 404 | artifact not found | False |
| Artifact status is Expired | 404 | Artifact has expired | False |
| Artifact is v3 | 404 | Artifact not found | False |

### Error Paths

- **Artifact not found or wrong repo** → ctx.APIError → 404
- **Artifact status is Expired** → ctx.APIError → 404
- **Artifact is v3** → ctx.APIError → 404
